desc: While many of CZ’s tactical handguns were born of competition guns, the new CZ P-10 F Competition-Ready pistol followed the opposite trajectory. The new P-10 F Competition-Ready utilizes the full-size P-10 F frame and has a barrel and slide that are a half-inch longer, providing a longer sight radius for the included fiber optic front sight and fixed serrated rear sight. Additionally, like other P-10 models, the slide is milled to accept mounting plates for the most popular micro red-dot optics on the market. The pistol is outfitted with an Apex Tactical extended magazine catch, extended slide stop, back slide cover along with a HB Industries trigger for increased performance. Since every competition gun needs a little flash, gold accents on the barrel slide cover and on the trigger and three magazines equipped with aluminum Henning Group bases make this handgun stand out in the P-10 line and on the firing line.
